correctness.rationale: The canonical GP(10,2) graph yields the symmetric edge polytope of dimension 19; polarity identifies facet normals with integer 1-Lipschitz functions modulo constants whose saturated-edge graph is connected. The tight connected graph must have a spanning tree, proving integrality, so rooted recursive assignment over all legal adjacent intervals exhausts the search. Independent distance BFS found layers 1,3,6,6,3,1 and center-normal span rank10, with explicit 10x10 determinant -2. Distance profiles have squared centered norm29 giving origin inradius 1/sqrt29 and 20 contacts; central symmetry proves global maximality and slack for other facets gives a local relative neighborhood of optimal centers in the rank-10 annihilator, hence affine dimension9. Entire arithmetic is finite and exhaustive because graph and integer-assignment completeness were proved; no claim about other Euclidean embeddings.
